scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:python
scripts.build:python: uv build --package zylora-api --out-dir dist/api && uv build --package zylora-worker --out-dir dist/worker
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run ruff format apps/api apps/worker scripts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run ruff format --check apps/api apps/worker scripts
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && uv run ruff check apps/api apps/worker scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && uv run mypy apps/api/src apps/worker/src scripts
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:python
scripts.test:integration: npm run migrate && uv run pytest apps/api/tests/integration --run-integration
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run python scripts/generate_openapi.py && openapi-typescript packages/contracts/openapi.json --output packages/contracts/src/api.generated.ts && prettier --write packages/contracts/openapi.json packages/contracts/src/api.generated.ts
scripts.contracts:check: npm run contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/openapi.json packages/contracts/src/api.generated.ts
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yml up -d --wait postgres redis minio mailpit
scripts.migrate: uv run --package zylora-api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.security: npm audit --audit-level=high && uv run pip-audit --local --skip-editable && uv run python scripts/check_forbidden_architecture.py && uv run python scripts/check_cloudflare_security.py
scripts.quality: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run contracts:check && npm run templates:check
scripts.dev:worker: uv run --package zylora-worker celery -A zylora_worker.celery_app:celery_app worker --loglevel=INFO --pool=solo
scripts.ai-builder:preflight:staging:canary: uv run python scripts/check_ai_builder_deployment.py --target staging --activation-state canary
scripts.ai-builder:preflight:production:canary: uv run python scripts/check_ai_builder_deployment.py --target production --activation-state canary
